title: Analysis of routine data in the IMPLEMENT-UKU project: A retrospective study for the years 2024-2025
summary:
The aim is to conduct a retrospective study using data analysis from the project-related routine documentation of the “IMPLEMENT-UKU” project.  In the project "IMPLEMENT-UKU", integrative nursing was implemented in an inpatient context for oncology patients as part of a consultation service on participating wards. 
The data to be analyzed were continuously collected and documented in the clinical routine of the project, as they were necessary for the transparency and traceability of the integrative nursing treatment. The data was already available in full at the time of this application, in the form of paper-based care documentation. 
The variables of the target variables are first extracted manually from the paper-based care documentation. During this simultaneous extraction and digitization of the data, it is also anonymized. The anonymized data is stored on an internal hospital PC drive and the data is not passed on externally. After this de facto anonymization, the data is made available for analysis and evaluated. 
The retrospective study, including the project-related routine data, makes it possible to generate statements on the implementation of integrative care (including reasons for the request, patient complaints and implementation of the integrative nursing interventions) and on the perception of the reaction by the nursing staff. The results thus enable a comprehensive assessment of the implementation of integrative nursing as part of the “IMPLEMENT-UKU” project. In addition, the results of this study can serve as a basis for generating hypotheses for further studies.
conditions: No restriction to one disease, but focus on oncology patients

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of all patients for whom an integrative nursing consultation was requested in the “IMPLEMENT-UKU” project between 01.01.2024 and 31.12.2025

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Request for an integrative nursing consultation for the patient
• Consultation requirement in the period from 01.01.2024 to 31.12.2025
• Availability of project-related routine documentation
Exclusion criteria:
If inclusion criteria are not met
